title: ThreadAtlas Step 1: Document Packages
subtitle: 81 documents read into entities, quote-backed facts, cells and abstracts
description:
What one language-model pass reads out of a document, one package per document: the entities the document is about, every fact with a verbatim quote located at character offsets into the document's text, a narrative cell per major entity per unit, the document's abstract, and an abstract per major entity. 81 documents, 6,929 facts, every quoted fact proven to slice from its document at its offsets, produced by a public notebook for $5.47.

**The test set, not the corpus.** These are the 81 documents the memory backend is built and tuned on before the full Step 0 corpus (24,071 documents) is read: one user's whole LongMemEval history (53 sessions), 18 answer sessions of 13 other questions, three Oz novels, five CC-BY papers, The Bacchae, and one GraphRAG-Bench novel.

**Version 2 (ingestor 1.8, 2026-09-14).** After a chat session is read, one more call gives each entity a kind (never `thing`) and marks it major or minor; a minor's facts are kept on the session's own node as `mentioned` facts with their quotes. Every document carries its record (title, author, date, source class, a chat's history) as facts built from Step 0 with no quote. The chats went from 1,061 entity nodes to 643.

**Every fact read from the text carries a verbatim quote and its offsets.** A claim that could not be found in its unit was rejected and logged, never stored; a fact its passage does not state was reworded or dropped. The 1,105 rejections are in the dataset with their category.

**Nothing is merged across documents.** Every entity, fact and edge belongs to one document. Connecting them is the next step.

**Files.** documents, units, pieces, nodes, aliases, edges, facts, cells, abstracts, adjudicated_facts, attributes, contradictions, rejections, ledger, candidates and completions as JSON Lines, one file per record type, every row keyed by doc_id (the same hash as Step 0); calls.jsonl with every model call's cost; attribution.jsonl for the papers; receipt.json. README.md, SCHEMA.md, METHOD.md, PROVENANCE.md and LIMITS.md are in the dataset. Document rows carry no text: slice quotes from ThreadAtlas Step 0.

**Licensing is layered.** Packaging, schema and every derived row are MIT. Quotes keep their document's license: Oz and Euripides are public domain in the United States, LongMemEval and GraphRAG-Bench are MIT, the five papers are CC-BY and attribution.jsonl carries what that requires.

**Known limits are documented.** Only a fact's subject becomes an entity; salience on chats is one model's judgement; kind and predicate are the model's own words; consolidated majors' raw facts were not individually support-checked; a rerun will differ. LIMITS.md gives the counts.

Made by https://www.kaggle.com/code/jhffmn/threadatlas-document-ingestor (threadatlas-ingestor 1.8, gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-5.6-terra on the Flex tier) from https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/jhffmn/it494-threadatlas-step0 (1.8).

IT 494 directed project, Illinois State University, fall 2026.
userSpecifiedSources:
SOURCES. ThreadAtlas Step 0 (https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/jhffmn/it494-threadatlas-step0, version 1.8), whose documents trace to Project Gutenberg (Oz, Euripides), LongMemEval-S (MIT, https://github.com/xiaowu0162/LongMemEval), GraphRAG-Bench (MIT, https://github.com/GraphRAG-Bench/GraphRAG-Benchmark) and 100 CC-BY papers from OpenAlex, of which five are read here.

PROCESSING. One pass of https://www.kaggle.com/code/jhffmn/threadatlas-document-ingestor (threadatlas-ingestor 1.8) on 2026-09-14 over 81 documents selected by path: gpt-5.6-luna reads each unit, or a chat session whole and then sorts its entities by kind and salience, and checks every fact against its passage; gpt-5.6-terra judges entity pairs, folds abstracts and consolidates a major's facts. Every fact read from the text has its quote located in its unit and stored with its offsets; a quote that is not found is rejected and logged. Each document's record (title, author, date, source class, history) is added as facts from Step 0 with no quote. The packages were regrouped one file per record type by scripts/pack_step1_public.py, which re-checked every quoted fact against Step 0's text. $5.47, 1,784 calls.

LICENSING. Packaging, schema and every derived row are MIT. Quotes keep their document's license: public domain (Oz, Euripides), MIT (LongMemEval, GraphRAG-Bench), CC-BY (the papers, with attribution.jsonl).

KNOWN LIMITS. The test set, not the corpus. Only a fact's subject becomes an entity. Salience on chats is one model's judgement per session. Kind and predicate are the model's words, not a controlled vocabulary. Nothing is merged across documents. A rerun will differ. LIMITS.md gives the counts. Not ground truth.

PART OF the IT 494 directed project, Illinois State University, fall 2026.
